en: Black‑and‑white view of a tree‑lined avenue in front of a large late‑19th‑century villa with elaborate window frames and a steep hipped roof. Behind it rise terraced, largely bare hillsides that appear to be vineyards. Scattered on the slope are several detached villas and, on the hilltop, a pavilion or small mansion. There is no visible printed caption or writing on the image.
